card.name: Linking words in arrhythmia drug context
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, in, to, e.g.,) or the start of a drug name, in passages about ventricular arrhythmias, antiarrhythmic drugs, or pediatric infusion rates.

modes.label: Linking word after administration
modes.description: The word 'of' right after 'administration' before an antiarrhythmic brand name.
modes.example: must be available during and after administration<< of>> CORVERT.

modes.label: Before pediatric patients
modes.description: The word 'in' before 'pediatric patients' in dosing statements.

modes.label: Antiarrhythmic examples list
modes.description: The 'e.g.,' or first letter of a drug name in a list of Class III antiarrhythmics or interacting drugs.

card.writes: No clear output effect beyond weakly favoring word starts like 'ger' and 'del' and suppressing 'facility' words.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words and list openers in heart-rhythm drug warnings and pediatric dosing lines.
